name: CN_REPOSITORIES_ALL_B
description: CN_REPOSITORIES stores default, control, and option information you provide to customize Oracle Sales Compensation to your company's needs. CN_REPOSITORIES corresponds to the System Parameters form.

columns.name: HR_SUPER_HIERARCHY_DEPTH
columns.description: Depth of HR supervisor hierarchy considered by seeded approval flow.

columns.name: ANALYST_HIERARCHY_DEPTH
columns.description: Depth of analyst hierarchy considered by approval process for the seeded flow.

columns.name: MAX_PMT_APPR_AMT
columns.description: maximum amount for payment auto approval

columns.name: HCM_FETCH_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the last time participant updates or terminates were fetched from HCM for this Business Unit

columns.name: MIN_PMT_APPR_AMT
columns.description: minimum amount for payment auto approval

columns.name: ANALYST_SECURITY
columns.description: Analyst Security by business unit or by participant hierarchy

columns.name: PAYMENT_DATE_CONV
columns.description: DAY ON WHICH CONVERSION SHOULD BE APPLIED WHETHER TRX DATE OR PAYMENT DATE

columns.name: CN_CUST_PLAN_COMP_FLAG
columns.description: The default value for the CUSTOMIZED_FLAG attribute that will apply to the plan component at the participant plan level.  Derived from CN_CUST_PLAN_COMP_OPTION.

columns.name: CN_CUST_PLAN_COMP_OPTION
columns.description: The default value for the CUSTOMIZED_OPTION attribute that will apply to the plan component at the participant plan level. It will affect any future added plan components.

columns.name: SRP_ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether transactions should rollup the management hierarchy during calculation

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PLAN_IMPORT_RESOLVE
columns.description: Column used to resolve the conflict during the import of Compensation Plan

columns.name: PLAN_APPROVAL_ENABLE_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate status of plan approval feature for the given BU

columns.name: DEFAULT_PLAN_DOC_TEMPLATE
columns.description: Stores the Plan Document Template Name which would be the default template for all the compensation plans in the BU unless the different template is chosen at the compensation plan level.

columns.name: PAYMENT_HOME_CURRENCY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Stores option to convert the payment processing amount to the participant currency in effect as of the incentive earning event date or their current home currency.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ENABLE_PARTICIPANT_TERMINATE
columns.description: Indicates if automated participant termination processing is enabled.

columns.name: COMP_END_DATE_PERIOD_OPTIONS
columns.description: The lookup code that represents the options for determining the compensation end date period when participants are terminated.

columns.name: COMP_END_DATE_PERIOD_COUNT
columns.description: The number of periods used to derive the compensation end date when participants are terminated.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_ASSIGN_TERMINATE
columns.description: The lookup code that represents how the plan assignment end date is determined when participants are terminated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PLAN_ASSIGN_TERMINATE
columns.description: The lookup code that represents how the payment plan assignment end date is determined when participants are terminated.

columns.name: TRX_CALC_METHOD
columns.description: Specifies the batch processing option to be used for calculation.

columns.name: CALC_BATCH_SIZE
columns.description: Maximum number of calc batches allowed to run at the same time.

columns.name: WORKER_INFORMATION
columns.description: Will specify the minimum value of the available workers for the organization. This will increase in step value of 1000 across organization . Hence range of available workers will be 1000

columns.name: DISABLE_INCR_CALCULATION
columns.description: This flag is used to determine whether Incremental Calc is Runnable for this BU

columns.name: ALLOW_FUTURE_DATED_PAYBATCH
columns.description: This flag is used to determine whether to allow Future Dated PayBatch Creation for this BU

columns.name: PAYMENT_LOOKBACK
columns.description: This column is used to determine the option chosen for payment write off.

columns.name: PAYSHEET_VISIBILITY
columns.description: This column controls the visibility of paysheets to analysts.

columns.name: PARALLEL_BU_ID
columns.description: Specifies the identifier for org_id used for parallel crediting for creating dynamic indexes.

columns.name: CALC_PROCESS_ORDER
columns.description: User selection to specify an attribute column in the transaction to order transactions which have the same source_event_date for calculation

columns.name: IMP_SRP_FUTURE_HIRE_DATE_FLAG
columns.description: This flag is used to determine whether future hire date participants can be imported

columns.name: IMP_NUM_DAYS_BEFORE_HIRE_DATE
columns.description: This flag is used to determine how many days before the hire date can a participant be imported

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: HCM_SRP_REHIRE_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the value for HCM participant rehire functionality. Possible values are Y indicating yes and N indicating no.

columns.name: HCM_REHIRE_NUM_NOGAP_DAYS
columns.description: Indicates the number of days within which, if a participant is rehired, gap record creation will be ignored.
